cohort: The study participants were 95 couples, comprising pregnant women without progressive psychiatric disorders or obstetric risk factors and their partners, enrolled at Lyon University Hospital.
finding: Overall, 15% of patients and 1% of partners had EPDS scores >10 in the postpartum period, with psychiatric history and emergency cesarean sections associated with higher immediate postpartum EPDS scores in patients, and episiotomy with higher EPDS scores in partners.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections were associated with higher immediate postpartum EPDS scores in patients, and episiotomy was associated with higher EPDS scores in partners.
